def: to share in company with, i.e. co-participate in
kjv: communicate (have fellowship) with, be partaker of

occurrences.text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
